-- Data Warehouse 102500.000000000000000

DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230113
SELECT  SUM(TotalRelationshipExposureFull) TotalRelationshipExposureFull 
FROM [DW].[FactTotalRelationshipExposure_TEST_20231026]
WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate
GROUP BY BusinessDateSK


SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactTotalRelationshipExposure_TEST_20231026]

-- DW Expected -3654684.00000

DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20230113;

WITH Loans AS (
       SELECT SUM(A.TotalRelationshipExposureFull)  TotalRelationshipExposureFull 
       FROM [DW].[FactLoansRelationshipExposure_TEST_20231024_2] A
       INNER JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK AND B.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS' AND B.AccountStatus <> 'Closed'
       WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate
), 
Cards AS (SELECT SUM(RelationshipExposure) TotalRelationshipExposureFull 
       FROM [DW].[FactCardsRelationshipExposure_TEST_20231011] A
       INNER JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK AND B.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS' AND B.AccountStatus <> 'Closed' WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate)

SELECT SUM(TotalRelationshipExposureFull) TotalRelationshipExposureFull
FROM ( SELECT * FROM Loans UNION ALL
       SELECT * FROM Cards
        ) A
